name: Autistic Parents UK
description: National autistic-led UK charity providing peer support, resources, education and community for autistic parents.
intended_use: Find autistic-led peer support and information specifically about navigating parenthood as an autistic person.
audience_or_context: Autistic parents in the UK and professionals or family members seeking to understand autistic parent perspectives.
limitations: Peer support is not therapy, crisis support or individual clinical advice.
Availability of groups, one-to-one support and events can depend on capacity and current programme rules.
cost_or_access_notes: Some peer-support and information routes are free; events, memberships or programmes may have their own access conditions.
conflicts_of_interest: The organisation is explicitly autistic-led and advocates from autistic-parent lived experience; ND Oracle preserves that standpoint rather than presenting it as universal.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
